step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features an on-premises data center ('DATA CENTER TX WA') connected via AWS Transit Gateway. The Transit Gateway routes traffic into an application stack comprising Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) and EC2 instances contained within a VPC environment. The EC2 instances interact with RDS for relational data storage, S3 for object storage, and send operational logs and metrics to Amazon CloudWatch.
